kevin: Ill draft the private VPC topology + security checklist (KMS, audit logs, peering) and add to repo by next Tue.
sophie: Legal wants the checklist before we commit to dates for Private onboarding.
kevin: noted, will prioritize the checklist and include an onboarding checklist for sales.
daria: Confirming Optimize priorities: batching/cache still top for Q2?
marta: Yes. Daria to publish perf targets and expected unit-cost impact in roadmap doc (due 2w).
olivia: Docs action: publish sample unit-cost worksheets (chat vs embeddings) and include 3 SE customer examples.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://storage.redwood.company/ah/2026-03-22/recording.mp4
marta: Action items recap: kevin: private topology + checklist (due next Tue); kevin: rollout playbook thresholds & dashboards (1w); daria: publish batching/cache perf targets (2w); olivia: unit-cost worksheets + examples (2w); marta: send deep-dive invite on routing/cost controls (this week). Reply to claim or adjust.
